definitions.explanation: Used to ask about one of two options.

examples.japanese: ⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{紅茶|こうちゃ}→紅茶：02878_koucha⟧、どっち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧？
examples.english: Coffee or tea, which will you have?
Red or blue, which do you like?

examples.japanese: ⟦{出口|でぐち}→出口：02508_deguchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧どっち？
どっち⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
⟦{東|ひがし}→東：02250_higashi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{西|にし}→西：00659_nishi⟧、どっち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曲|ま}がる→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧？
examples.english: East or west, which way do we turn?

examples.japanese: どっち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧？
どっち⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧？
examples.english: Which way did you come from?

notes:
どっち is the casual form of ⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧, used to ask "which one" (of two) or "which way."

KO-SO-A-DO SERIES:
- ⟦こっち→こっち：02903_kocchi⟧: this way / this one (near speaker)
- ⟦そっち→そっち：02908_socchi⟧: that way / that one (near listener)
- ⟦あっち→あっち：02891_acchi⟧: over there / that one (far from both)
- どっち: which way / which one (question)

REGISTER:
- どっち: casual (used with friends, family)
- ⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧: polite (used in formal situations, with strangers)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- どっち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧？: Which one is better?
- どっち⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: Either is fine.
- どっち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧？: Which will you choose?
- どっち⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いうと→言う：00515_iu⟧: if I had to choose / rather

USAGE:
Used for choosing between two options. For three or more, use ⟦どれ→どれ：00547_dore⟧ (casual) or ⟦どれ→どれ：00547_dore⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧.
